calls.title: GrowthBook and Dentsu
calls.summary: Dentsu is moving towards adopting Growth Book as its core platform for A/B testing, pending legal approval, with a strong internal interest and a planned technical kickoff in September. They aim to build an internal platform using Growth Book's code, targeting mid to low-budget clients in sectors like energy and automotive with flexible CRO solutions. Leadership roles were clarified, with Enrico, Simone, and Ricardo overseeing the initiative while Gaia manages legal contact. There's an urgent need for customized sales materials to support legal approval and showcase client demand. A phased implementation timeline is set, emphasizing ongoing communication to maintain momentum, while Growth Book's flexibility presents a competitive advantage in appealing to a diverse client base.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Dentsu, A/B testing, legal approval, visual editor, client pipeline
